40010804.author: पदार्थः
40010804.content: वानरेन्द्रेषु when the monkey chieftains, गतेषु had gone, रामः Rama, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, अब्रवीत् said, भवान् you, भुवः of the earth, सर्वम् entire, मण्डलम् region, कथम् how, विजानीते do you know

40010804.author: Translation
40010804.content: When the chieftains of the monkeys left, Rama enquired Sugriva, how he had come to know  the regions of the entire earth (which is a mandala. a circular form).

40010805.author: पदार्थः
40010805.content: ततः then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्रणतात्मवान् offered reverential salutation, रामम् to Rama, उवाच spoke, सर्वम् all, विस्तरेण in detail, आख्यास्ये narrate, नरर्षभ O Rama, श्रूयताम् listen.

40010805.author: Translation
40010805.content: Then offering reverential salutation to Rama, Sugriva said, 'I shall narrate in detail. Listen, O bull among men

40010806.author: पदार्थः
40010806.content: वाली Vali, महिषाकृतिम् in buffalo form, दुन्दुभिं नाम named Dundubhi, दानवम् demon, यदा when, मलयं पर्वतं प्रति till the mount Malaya, प्रतिकालयते wished to kill him, तदा then, महिषः buffalo, मलयस्य Malaya's, गुहां प्रति towards the cave, विवेश entered, वाली Vali, तज्जिघांसया with the intention of killing him, तत्रापि into that, मलयम् Malaya, विवेश entered.

40010806.author: Translation
40010806.content: Vali chased the demon Dundubhi in buffalo form into a cave of mount Malaya in order to kill him.

40010807.author: पदार्थः
40010807.content: वाली Vali, महिषाकृतिम् in buffalo form, दुन्दुभिं नाम named Dundubhi, दानवम् demon, यदा when, मलयं पर्वतं प्रति till the mount Malaya, प्रतिकालयते wished to kill him, तदा then, महिषः buffalo, मलयस्य Malaya's, गुहां प्रति towards the cave, विवेश entered, वाली Vali, तज्जिघांसया with the intention of killing him, तत्रापि into that, मलयम् Malaya, विवेश entered.

40010807.author: Translation
40010807.content: Vali chased the demon Dundubhi in buffalo form into a cave of mount Malaya in order to kill him.

40010808.author: पदार्थः
40010808.content: ततः then, विनीतवत् with due loyalty, अहम् I, तत्र there, गुहाद्वारि निक्षिप्तः I was made to wait at the entrance of the cave, तदा then, संवत्सरे when a year, गते passed, वाली Vali, न निष्क्रामते not returned.

40010808.author: Translation
40010808.content: 'Then I waited at the entrance of the cave with due loyalty. A year passed. Yet Vali did not return.

40010809.author: पदार्थः
40010809.content: ततः then, बिलम् cave, क्षतजवेगेन with the speed of the gushing blood, आपुपूरे filled with, तदा then, अहम् I, तत् that, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, विस्मितः bewildered, भ्रातुः brother, शोकविषार्दितः suffered intense agony.

40010809.author: Translation
40010809.content: 'There seeing the cave overflowing with the gushing blood, I was bewildered, thinking that my brother might have been killed. I suffered intense agony.

40010810.author: पदार्थः
40010810.content: अथ then, गुरुः brother Vali, सुव्यक्तम् it is evident, निहतः killed, अहम् I, कृतबुद्धिः I thought, महिषः buffalo, निष्क्रमितुम् to return, अशक्नुवन् being unable, विनशेदिति should be destroyed, मया by myself, पर्वतसङ्काशा of the mountain size, शिला rock, बिलद्वारि at the entrance of, कृता placed.

40010810.author: Translation
40010810.content: 'Thereafter, convinced that my brother was killed, I placed a mountainsize rock at the entrance of the cave so that Dundubhi will be destroyed, unable to come out of the cave.

40010811.author: पदार्थः
40010811.content: ततः then, अहम् I, तस्य his, जीविते about his life, निराशः lost hope, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, आगाम् I came, सुमहत्  great, राज्यं च kingdom also, रुमया सह with Ruma, तार या with Tara, प्राप्य having got, तत्र there, मित्रैः with friends, सहितः accompanied, विगतज्वरः fearlessly, वसामि I lived.

40010811.author: Translation
40010811.content: 'I lost hope of his life and came back to Kishkinda. Having got the kingdom, and also Ruma and Tara, I was anointed king and ruled it fearlessly with all friends.

40010812.author: पदार्थः
40010812.content: ततः then, अहम् I, तस्य his, जीविते about his life, निराशः lost hope, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, आगाम् I came, सुमहत्  great, राज्यं च kingdom also, रुमया सह with Ruma, तार या with Tara, प्राप्य having got, तत्र there, मित्रैः with friends, सहितः accompanied, विगतज्वरः fearlessly, वसामि I lived.

40010812.author: Translation
40010812.content: 'I lost hope of his life and came back to Kishkinda. Having got the kingdom, and also Ruma and Tara, I was anointed king and ruled it fearlessly with all friends.

40010813.author: पदार्थः
40010813.content: ततः then, दानवर्षभम् bull among monsters वाली Vali, तम् him, हत्वा after killing, आजगाम he came, ततः then, अहम् I, भययन्त्रितः constrained with fear, गौरवात् with respect, राज्यम् kingdom, अददाम् returned.

40010813.author: Translation
40010813.content: Then Vali, having slain that bull among danavas, returned; and I, constrained by fear yet out of respect, gave the kingdom back to him.

40010814.author: पदार्थः
40010814.content: दुष्टात्मा evilminded, सः वाली that Vali, प्रव्यथितेन्द्रियः having lost control over his senses, सचिवैस्सह along with ministers, धावन्तम् while I was running, माम् me, जिघांसुः to kill, क्रोधात् enraged, परिकालयते ran after me.

40010814.author: Translation
40010814.content: 'The evilminded Vali, having lost his selfcontrol, ran after me in anger, to kill me and my ministers. I kept running.

40010815.author: पदार्थः
40010815.content: ततः then, तेन by him, वालिना by Vali, अनुबद्धः chased, सः अहम् that I was, विविधाः many, नदीः rivers, वनानि forests, नगराणि च towns, पश्यन् while seeing, प्रधावितः I ran.

40010815.author: Translation
40010815.content: Then, chased by that Vali, I fled, seeing many rivers, forests and cities pass by.

40010816.author: पदार्थः
40010816.content: ततः then, मया by me, पृथिवी the earth, आदर्शतलसङ्काशा like the surface of a mirror, अलातचक्रप्रतिमा  like a circling of fireband, दृष्टा seen, गोष्पदवत् as though it is of the size of cow's hoof, तदा then.

40010816.author: Translation
40010816.content: Then I saw the earth as though it were the surface of a mirror, like a whirling firebrand, appearing as small as a cow's hoof-print.

40010817.author: पदार्थः
40010817.content: ततः then, पूर्वां दिशम् eastern quarter, गत्वा after going, विविधान् several, द्रुमान् trees, नदीन् rivers, रम्यान् delighting, पर्वतान् mountains, विविधानि many, सरांसि च lakes also, पश्यामि see (saw).

40010817.author: Translation
40010817.content: 'Then I ran in the eastern direction and saw many trees, lakes, rivers and beautiful mountains.

40010818.author: पदार्थः
40010818.content: तत्र there, धातुमण्डितम् embellished with minerals, उदयं पर्वतम् mountain behind which the Sun rises, नित्यम् always, अप्सरसालयम् frequented by apsaras, क्षीरोदं सागरं चैव the milky ocean also, पश्यामि see (saw).

40010818.author: Translation
40010818.content: 'There I saw, filled with minerals the mountain behind which the Sun rises and the milky ocean frequented by the apsaras.

40010819.author: पदार्थः
40010819.content: विभो O king, वालिना by Vali, परिकालयमानः chased away, अहम् I, तदा then, अभिद्रुतः I ran, तदा then, पुनः again, आवृत्य I turned back, सहसा at once, प्रस्थितः I left.

40010819.author: Translation
40010819.content: 'O king chased thus by Vali, I ran and turned back and ran againfast.

40010820.author: पदार्थः
40010820.content: पुनः again, आवर्तमानः changing, वलिना by Vali, द्रुतम् fast, अभिद्रुतः chased, ततः then, तस्याः that, दिशः direction, भूयः turned, विन्ध्यपादपसङ्कीर्णाम् filled with the mountains of Vindhya and trees, चन्दनद्रुमशोभिताम् filled with beautiful sandal trees, दक्षिणां दिशम् southern quarter, प्रस्थितः ran.

40010820.author: Translation
40010820.content: 'Then chased by Vali, I changed my present direction from the east towards the southern quarter where Vindhya mountain stood with its, beautiful sandal trees.

40010821.author: पदार्थः
40010821.content: द्रुमशैलां trees and mountains, दक्षिणतः from the southern quarter, अपराम् another, पश्यन् while seeing, भूयः again, वालिना by Vali, समभिद्रुतः chased, पश्चिमां दिशम् western quarter, प्राप्ताः I reached.

40010821.author: Translation
40010821.content: 'I was looking at the trees and mountains in the southern direction, I reached the western quarter pursued by Vali.

40010822.author: पदार्थः
40010822.content: विविधान् many, देशान् places, गिरिसत्तमम् best of mountains, अस्तं च where the Sun sets, पश्यन् while I was seeing, गिरिश्रेष्ठम् foremost of mountains, अस्तम् where the Sun sets, प्राप्य having  reached, उत्तराम्  northern, सम्प्रधावितः ran.

40010822.author: Translation
40010822.content: 'Looking at the places around, I reached the best of mountains where the Sun sets (I found Vali still chasing me) and ran towards the north.

40010823.author: पदार्थः
40010823.content: हिमवन्तं च Himavanta also, मेरुं च Meru also, तथा so also, उत्तरं समुद्रं च even the northern sea, वालिना by Vali, समभिद्रुतः chased, यदा when, शरणम् protection, न विन्दम् I did not get, तदा then, बुद्धिसम्पन्नः wise, हनूमान् Hanuman, माम् to me, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत्  spoke.

40010823.author: Translation
40010823.content: 'I saw Himavan and mount Meru on the north and the northern sea. Still pursued by Vali, I could not know where to go when wise Hanuman spoke to me these words:

40010824.author: पदार्थः
40010824.content: राजन् O king, हरीश्वरः king of monkeys, वाली Vali, तदा then, मतङ्गेन by Mathanga, यथा as, शप्तः cursed, मे to me, इदानीम् now, स्मृतम् I remembered, वाली Vali, अस्मिन् in this, आश्रममण्डले hermitage site, प्रविशेद्यदि if he enters, अस्य his, मूर्धा head, शतधा hundred pieces, भवेत् will become, तत्र there, अस्माकम् to us, वासः residence, सुखः happy, निरुद्विग्नः peaceful, भविष्यति will be.

40010824.author: Translation
40010824.content: 'I remembed Matanga's curse to Vali, king of monkeys. Vali would not enter the site of Matanga's hermitage as his head would break into a hundred pieces if he did'. Therefore  we thought it would be safe for us to reside in that place.

40010825.author: पदार्थः
40010825.content: राजन् O king, हरीश्वरः king of monkeys, वाली Vali, तदा then, मतङ्गेन by Mathanga, यथा as, शप्तः cursed, मे to me, इदानीम् now, स्मृतम् I remembered, वाली Vali, अस्मिन् in this, आश्रममण्डले hermitage site, प्रविशेद्यदि if he enters, अस्य his, मूर्धा head, शतधा hundred pieces, भवेत् will become, तत्र there, अस्माकम् to us, वासः residence, सुखः happy, निरुद्विग्नः peaceful, भविष्यति will be.

40010825.author: Translation
40010825.content: 'I remembed Matanga's curse to Vali, king of monkeys. Vali would not enter the site of Matanga's hermitage as his head would break into a hundred pieces if he did'. Therefore  we thought it would be safe for us to reside in that place.

40010826.author: पदार्थः
40010826.content: नृपात्मज  O prince Rama, ततः from that place, ऋष्यमूकं पर्वतम् mountain Rishyamuka, तदा then, आसाद्य having reached, वाली Vali, मतङ्गस्य Matanga's, भयात् out of fear of, तदा then, न विवेश did not enter.

40010826.author: Translation
40010826.content: 'O prince Rama then I reached mount Rishyamuka which Vali did not enter out of fear of the curse of Matanga.

40010827.author: पदार्थः
40010827.content: राजन् king, एवम् in that manner, तदा then, कत्स्नम् पृथिवीमण्डलम् entire earth, प्रत्यक्षम् saw directly, मया by me, उपलक्षितम् is surveyed, गुहाम् this cave, ततः thereafter, आगतः reached, अस्मि I am.

40010827.author: Translation
40010827.content: 'O king that way I surveyed the entire earth directly and returned to this cave and lived here. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षटचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
